summary: This report recommends approval of a loan of $5.0 million to the Toronto Zoo to finance the installation of a special exhibit Lumina experience at the Toronto Zoo for an opening in December 2019.
decided: City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council increase the Approved 2019 Operating Budget for the Toronto Zoo by $5 million gross, fully funded by a disbursement of undesignated funds held for the Toronto Zoo from the Toronto Foundation, for the Board of Management to enter into a contract with the Moment Factory to implement the Lumina Project, with such project to be managed as a fund separate from the Zoo's City-funded Operating Budget and with net proceeds to be contributed to either the Toronto Foundation or the Toronto Zoo Wildlife Conservancy at the direction of the Toronto Zoo Board of Management.

text: This report recommends approval of a loan of $5.0 million to the Toronto Zoo to finance the installation of a special exhibit Lumina experience at the Toronto Zoo for an opening in December 2019.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council increase the Approved 2019 Operating Budget for the Toronto Zoo by $5 million gross, fully funded by a disbursement of undesignated funds held for the Toronto Zoo from the Toronto Foundation, for the Board of Management to enter into a contract with the Moment Factory to implement the Lumina Project, with such project to be managed as a fund separate from the Zoo's City-funded Operating Budget and with net proceeds to be contributed to either the Toronto Foundation or the Toronto Zoo Wildlife Conservancy at the direction of the Toronto Zoo Board of Management.
